== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Kintan Strider (Japanese Premiere Two-Player)|Kintan Strider]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://swccgcards.com/product/jpn-premiere-wb-ds-kintan-strider/ SWCCGcards], [https://swccgcards.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/jpn_premiere_wb_ds_Kintan_Strider.png source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(8, 6, 843, 1194)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>4a8cbdf953e7e9de5877b94c9717239cef9abb2d566b7b2550d67b24ca47fb0a</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
